pages.text: Press $(k:puffish_skills.open) and start planning your tree — six skill trees, 40 levels each, 75 earnable points.

$(bold)Opening:$() $(k:puffish_skills.open). The skill menu shows all six trees and your current point allocation.$(br2)$(bold)Point sources:$() completing Heracles quests ($(k:heracles.open_quests)). No XP-for-points — anti-farming by design.

$(bold)Respec:$() 5 XP levels per point refunded. A full respec of 75 points costs 375 levels — expensive but possible at endgame. Partial respecs (single tree) are more affordable.$(br2)$(bold)Next: browse the six trees in $(l:icraft:skills/skills_overview)Skill Trees — Overview$(/l) before you spend your first point.$()
